import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_37/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_37/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source2_37_0 and Source2_37_1 on 'Date'
joined = pd.merge(df0[['Date']], df1[['Date', 'NumMosquitos']], on='Date', how='inner')

# Group by Date and sum NumMosquitos
grouped = joined.groupby('Date', as_index=False)['NumMosquitos'].sum()

# Ensure correct dtypes: Date as string, NumMosquitos as int
grouped['Date'] = grouped['Date'].astype(str)
grouped['NumMosquitos'] = grouped['NumMosquitos'].astype(int)

# Save to target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_37/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_37/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_37/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on Date column (inner join to keep only matching dates)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='Date', right_on='Date')

# Group by Date and sum NumMosquitos
result = joined.groupby('Date', as_index=False)['NumMosquitos'].sum()

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_37/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
